name: Glasgow Summer - Scottish Blind Off 2024

venue.name: Learning and Teaching Building, Strathclyde University

information:
### This competition will take place in the Glasgow venue of FMC 2024 immediately after the third attempt finishes. FMC 2024 will take place 11:00am - 3:30pm. Registration for this venue for FMC 2024 is **free**; please register for the competition [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMC2024) if you would like to participate. Please note registration for both competitions is separate.

This is a Blindfolded specialist competition. **We do not recommend this competition to first time competitors**.

Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above.

The winner of 5x5 Blindfolded will be announced as the winner of the competition.
